summary: Frontend-only verification of tap-to-call links on About and Home founder cards, on Desktop 1920 and Mobile 390 viewports. All 8 tel: hrefs verified correct, WhatsApp links preserved, About section order intact, zero pageerrors, no horizontal overflow on mobile.

design_issues.screen: Mobile (390) About & Home founder call/message links
issues: Tap targets are 31px tall — below the 44px Apple/48px Google minimum. Still tappable but marginal. Consider increasing vertical padding on the CALL/MESSAGE anchors for better mobile ergonomics.

critical_code_review_comments: Tap target height (31px) on mobile call/message anchors is below WCAG 2.5.5 / iOS HIG recommended 44px. Non-blocking but recommended enhancement.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 8 tel: hrefs verified across Home and About on desktop 1920 and mobile 390. WhatsApp links unchanged (3 wa.me links on home). No page errors. Only observation: mobile tap targets 31px tall — cosmetic.
